failures.claim: In the current period, reputational and client franchise risk was flagged as changed since the prior period due to increased external scrutiny and engagement activity; flood exposure risk and stranded assets risk were not flagged as changed.

Under orderly transition scenarios (short to medium term), the portfolio demonstrates adequate resilience; the entity monitors this through internal capital and risk metrics and does not disclose Pillar 2 buffer thresholds in this section.

Under disorderly transition scenarios, near-term resilience is acceptable but medium-term capital consumption from stranded asset impairments is material; additional capital buffers may be required post-2030 under the most adverse disorderly assumptions.

In the current period, climate-related considerations are reflected in credit risk processes and monitoring, collateral valuation governance for flood-exposed mortgages, pursuit of fee and lending opportunities, and operating/capital expenditure for climate initiatives; quantitative line-item impacts are not separately tracked as climate-only amounts.
Financed emissions for 2024 are reported as 35,973,167.6878965 tCO2e.

As at 2024, target progress is reported as: Scope 1 and Scope 2 progress 40.0%, Scope 3 Category 15 (financed) progress 25.0%, and net zero progress (all scopes) 13.3%; a portfolio intensity target of 20.0 tCO2e per EUR million is monitored.
Financed emissions input composition includes 47.5% estimated economic, 35.5% CDP disclosure, 0.7% audited report, and 16.3% other internal and third-party sources.

Total assets are EUR 763,922.8 million (2022), EUR 820,167.2 million (2023) and EUR 850,000.0 million (2024); total revenue is EUR 25,466.1 million (2022), EUR 27,779.7 million (2023) and EUR 24,136.2 million (2024); Tier 1 capital is EUR 95,149.4 million (2022), EUR 143,979.2 million (2023) and EUR 151,208.6 million (2024).
Planned funding sources for the climate strategy include operating cash flows, capital allocation within annual budgeting and multi-year strategic plan, and client-linked financing activity.

The Strategy disclosure uses reasonable and supportable information available at the reporting date without undue cost or effort, and methods are designed to be commensurate with capabilities and resources and refined as data and modelling improve.
